name: Zepto
tagline: Pure-play quick-commerce startup delivering groceries and essentials in minutes
facts: Private (public Ltd entity); IPO deferred to 2027
FY26 ₹5,905 cr; adj. EBITDA loss ₹5,041 cr

strategy.label: Mission
strategy.text: Make quick commerce the default way India shops for daily needs, with speed and selection.

strategy.label: Vision
strategy.text: Become India's largest consumer platform for everyday purchases, then layer ads, cafe and fintech on top.

strategy.label: Core strategy
strategy.text: Out-execute on store density and speed in top metros; own inventory after shifting to principal model in Jan 2025.

strategy.label: Key bet
strategy.text: Zepto Cafe, Zepto Atom data and ads business raise contribution per order while EBITDA loss per order falls (₹136 to ₹79).

strategy.label: Lesson
strategy.text: Public investors priced Zepto at ~$2.3B vs $7B private mark; growth without profit path no longer clears IPO.

strategy.label: Your view
strategy.text: Should Zepto cut burn to list at a lower valuation, or keep funding share gains privately until 2027?

customers.pain: No time to cook or shop; want snacks, essentials instantly
customers.why: Fast delivery, snacks, Zepto Cafe coffee and meals in one app

customers.who: Metro families topping up groceries weekly
customers.pain: Quick commerce prices and fees feel higher than DMart
customers.why: Zepto Pass free delivery, Super Saver pricing and frequent discounts

customers.who: FMCG, D2C brands and new launches
customers.pain: Need visibility and fast sell-through data by pin code
customers.why: Sponsored listings, sampling and Zepto Atom analytics on demand

customers.who: Distributors and brands supplying dark stores
customers.pain: Payment terms, margin pressure, data opacity
customers.why: High-velocity offtake across 1,100+ stores in top cities
Short trips within ~2-3 km, dense order flow, weekly payouts

products.name: Zepto app
products.desc: Groceries, fresh, personal care, electronics in minutes

products.name: Super Saver
products.desc: Value mode with lower prices for price-sensitive users

products.name: Zepto Pass
products.desc: Membership with free delivery and extra discounts

products.name: Private labels
products.desc: Own brands in staples and household for margin

portfolio.north_star: Weekly ordering households with contribution-positive baskets
portfolio.key_metrics: Orders/store/day, AOV, retention, EBITDA loss per order
portfolio.guardrails: Delivery SLA, fill rate, wastage, rider safety, fee complaints

products.name: Zepto Cafe
products.desc: In-store kitchens serving coffee, snacks and quick meals

products.name: Cafe standalone app
products.desc: Separate app to scale food beyond grocery users

portfolio.north_star: Cafe orders per active user per week
portfolio.key_metrics: Cafe attach rate, gross margin, kitchen throughput
portfolio.guardrails: Food safety incidents, prep time, quality ratings

products.name: Zepto Ads
products.desc: Search, display and sampling for brands

products.name: Zepto Atom
products.desc: Paid demand and sales analytics for brands

products.name: Customer fees
products.desc: Handling, small-cart, rain and late-night fees

portfolio.key_metrics: Ad revenue % of NRV, advertiser count, Atom subscribers
portfolio.guardrails: Search relevance, fee-driven churn, brand ROI

rows.how: Buy-sell margin on owned inventory via Indian-owned entity
Ads, sampling, Zepto Atom analytics subscriptions
Delivery, handling, small-cart, surge fees per order
Prepared food margin from in-store kitchens

bullets.label: Revenue mix
bullets.text: Inventory sales dominate reported revenue after Jan 2025 principal shift; ads and fees drive most margin.

bullets.label: Users vs payers
bullets.text: Consumers pay for goods and fees; brands pay for ads and data; investors fund the losses.

bullets.label: Unit economics
bullets.text: Adj. EBITDA loss per order improved ₹136 to ₹79 in FY26, but AOV stuck near ₹390.

bullets.label: Growth levers
bullets.text: Raise AOV via electronics and Cafe, mature stores, ads, densify top 10 cities, cut CAC.

bullets.label: Funding
bullets.text: ~$1.8B raised; $7B valuation Oct 2025; 2026 pre-IPO round at ~$4-4.6B led by domestic investors.

friction: Many add-on fees inflate small-basket checkout price
Delivery promise slips during rain and peak hours
Fresh produce quality inconsistent across stores
Hard to reach a human for refund disputes
Aggressive notifications and dark-pattern upsells irritate users

competitors.label: Quick commerce
competitors.text: Blinkit (leader, ~50% share), Swiggy Instamart, BigBasket BB Now

competitors.label: Cafe/food
competitors.text: Swiggy Bolt/Snacc, Blinkit Bistro, Starbucks, local cafes

competitors.label: Edge
competitors.text: Fastest execution culture; #2 by orders (640M FY26) ahead of Instamart

competitors.label: Risk
competitors.text: Cash burn plus IPO valuation reset; Blinkit profitable, Amazon subsidising entry

news.label: Aug 2026
news.text: IPO deferred after anchors offered ~$2.3B; listing now targeted Feb-May 2027

news.label: Jun 2026
news.text: Updated DRHP: ₹8,010 cr fresh issue; FY26 revenue ₹22,623 cr, loss ₹5,905 cr

news.label: Jan 2026
news.text: Dropped 10-minute delivery branding after Labour Ministry rider-safety push

news.label: Watch
news.text: EBITDA breakeven timeline, unlisted share price, 2027 IPO pricing

sources: Zepto UDRHP (Jun 2026), Bloomberg, Inc42, Outlook Business, The Ken coverage. Metrics are PM estimates for interview prep. Prepared Oct 2026.
